events.verdict: Siakam (IND) firms up on to his left leg in LeVert's (ATL) path and absorbs the contact.
After communicating with the Replay Center, Nembhard's (IND) three-point field goal was overturned and ruled a successful two-point field goal.
Nembhard (IND) goes to, not through Young's (ATL) space, as the pair make marginal contact with each other during the pick.
Nesmith (IND) moves alongside LeVert's (ATL) path and marginal body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Daniels (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position and incidental contact occurs as he defends Mathurin (IND) during the drive.
Young (ATL) extends his right hand and initiates contact to Turner's (IND) face before he starts his upward motion.
Niang (ATL) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. Play resumes with Indiana retaining the possession.
LeVert (ATL) briefly brings both hands to Mathurin's (IND) arm and marginal contact occurs during the rip-through.
Daniels (ATL) inbounds the ball within the five seconds.
Nembhard (IND) commits a take foul on Young (ATL).
Siakam (IND) brings his off-arm toward Daniels' (ATL) side and marginal contact occurs as Siakam attempts to dribble around Daniels during the drive.
Nesmith (IND) commits a take foul on Young (ATL).
On Young's (ATL) free throw attempt, the ball successfully makes contact with the rim, avoiding a free throw violation.
